Subject: Economic buyer & budget owner follow-up - Acme Corp

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery:

- Primary use case: dynamic content generation for product descriptions and internal support triage.
- Key success metrics: latency under 300ms p50 for API calls, overall TCO target ~30% below current vendor, and predictable throughput during peak campaign periods.
- Compliance asks you called out: SOC 2 report, data residency controls, and audit log access for product telemetry.

Next steps I promised:
1) Share a short mutual action plan (attached) that outlines stakeholders, timeline, and deliverables.
2) Connect with the economic buyer and the person who owns the budget so we can align on procurement and a pilot scope.
3) Schedule a 30-min meeting next week to review MAP and preliminary pricing.

Can you confirm who at Acme owns the budget (economic buyer) and whether procurement needs to be looped into the initial pilot discussion? If you can introduce me to the right person, I'll include Vivek (solutions engineer) for a technical/ops overview.

Attachment: ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
https://redwood.ai

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the recap and the MAP. Quick answers:

- The economic buyer / budget owner for this initiative is Carlos Mendoza (VP, Product) - carlos.mendoza@acme.com. He signs off on pilot budgets up to $150k.
- Procurement should be involved once we hit pilot scoping and any contractual terms - procurement@acme.com will handle standard SOW/contract questions.
- Security will likely want our standard questionnaire and SOC 2; I can route your security packet to our InfoSec team once Carlos is comfortable.

Please go ahead and loop Carlos on the MAP and propose a 30-minute slot next week. I'm happy to join the first intro but will likely hand over ownership to Carlos and procurement after that.

Thanks,

Subject: Intro + MAP: Redwood + Acme (pilot scope & next steps)

Hi Carlos,

Emma kindly introduced us. I'm Marissa (AE at Redwood Inference) - we help engineering teams serve LLM inference with consistent low latency and predictable unit economics across hosted and private deployments. Vivek (cc) is our solutions engineer and will join the technical portion.

Attached is a short mutual action plan that outlines a 6-8 week pilot: pilot goals, success criteria, roles, and an initial timeline. High level asks for the pilot:
- Pilot scope: product description generation + support triage for a 2-week A/B evaluation.
- Success criteria: 5-10% improvement in content velocity, stable p50 latency <300ms, and acceptable cost per 1k tokens.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min intro next week to align on scope and budget (we'll share a ballpark pricing range ahead of the call).
2) If aligned, procurement/Legal will receive our standard security and contract packet (SOC 2 + sample MSA).
3) Pilot kickoff and 2-week evaluation.

Here are three proposed times (all PST):
- Tue 11/23 10:00-10:30
- Wed 11/24 15:00-15:30
- Thu 11/25 09:00-09:30

If none of those work, share a few times or use my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/acme-intro

Attachment: ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-001

Vivek, for the intro call, could you prepare a short slide on expected latency profiles and our SOC 2 deliverables?

Thanks and looking forward to connecting.

Best,
